title_en: From Down the Mine to Out on the Water
note_en: 随 A 而 B expresses direct dependence: B changes along with A. 随 goes before what changes first, and 而 introduces the result. In the text: 发电量随天气变化而波动 "power output fluctuates with the weather." It's a written structure; near the end its short form 随之 "along with it" appears: 发电量随天气起落，他的心情也随之起落 "output rises and falls with the weather, and his mood rises and falls along with it."
